blocks.x: Regulatory Compliance Automation — an Achala packaged solution: a named business problem, a composed architecture from two to four service domains, and a value case written in units a CFO recognizes. Sized and piloted in weeks, measured on the metric it exists to move.
Controls live in spreadsheets; evidence is assembled in panic; every framework audit restarts from zero; DORA/PCI/AI-Act expectations keep growing.

The failure Regulatory Compliance Automation answers is structural, not personal: processes that grew by accretion now decide things faster than they can be checked. Engineering the path is cheaper than hiring around it.

We implement the unified control register with continuous testing and automated evidence collection, mapped across SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS 4.0, DORA and privacy regimes, audits become sampling against a live control plane.
For Regulatory Compliance Automation, the build decomposes into named pieces, each with an owner and a gate:

items: automated control checks with failing-control workflows
artifacts tied to systems, timestamps, owners
DORA, PCI DSS 4.0, AI Act, privacy-specific programs
auditor-facing evidence views with scope selection

blocks.x: Regulatory Compliance Automation composes Driisti Smart Vision Glasses, Tele Medicine Platform, platforms with documented controls and evidence packs, so governance is part of the runtime. The pattern is in delivery now in Banking & Financial Services, Insurance & Risk, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Technology & SaaS.

The Regulatory Compliance Automation engagement opens with the problem stated in the CFO's units and a baseline signed by whoever owns the number. Design follows with the risk envelope explicit; the proof phase runs a bounded slice on your data with falsifiable gate criteria; industrialization scales only what the evidence supports. In Regulatory Compliance Automation programs the same rule applies: nothing scales on a demo. The gate criteria are written with your team, and the pilot runs on your data before any rollout plan exists.
What your control owner sees weekly
The Regulatory Compliance Automation value case names what should move and by what mechanism. The numbers get filled in from your baseline, not from a brochure.
A value assessment prices the delta in your estate before anything is signed: Regulatory Compliance Automation, measured against your baseline, in two weeks.
